name: Overlapped Visapult Back End
aliases: Visapult Back End with Overlapped Data Loading and Rendering
definition: A method to overlap volume data loading and rendering in a distributed visualization system by using a detached reader thread and an MPI render process within each processing element (PE), synchronized via SystemV semaphores and shared memory.
summary: The Overlapped Visapult Back End hides I/O latency by overlapping data loading and rendering within a single node using shared memory, avoiding large MPI transfers.
